messages:
Nina Alvarez: Flagging my contract end: April 2 (UTC). I'm wrapping up handoffs and have a few questions: visa sponsorship wrap, final invoice timeline, and how my stock option exercise window works after contract end. Also need guidance on returning equipment in London.
Lila (People Ops): Thanks Nina. We'll kick off the offboarding checklist. Can you confirm your preferred last working hour (timezone)? We'll schedule an exit interview and send the contractor offboarding form. Also, are you asking about the option exercise COBRA-equivalent or post-contract exercise window?
Nina Alvarez: Last working hour 17:00 BST on Apr 2. For options: I saw a note in onboarding about a 90-day exercise window after separation for employees, but as a contractor I'm not sure. Can Legal confirm.
Samir Khan: I'll take KT ownership. Please record a 20m walkthrough of the analytics pipeline and add the runbook links. I'll also collect the list of owners for the three active tasks: analytics-alerts, billing-export, model-ops.
Nina Alvarez: Added runbook links: https://notion.redwood/prod-analytics/runbooks and https://drive.redwood/sas/contractor-nina. Owners: @Samir for alerts, @Hiring Ops for billing-export handoff, @Legal for contract closeout.
IT Ops: For device return: we can schedule courier pickup in London on Apr 3 or you can drop at the London office before Apr 2 EOD. Which works? Note: VPN and SSO deprovision scheduled Apr 3 09:00 BST.
Nina Alvarez: Courier pickup Apr 3 works. Please provide prepaid label. Also confirm we will remove my SSH keys and transfer any service account ownerships before deprovision.
IT Ops: Confirmed. Deprovision plan (high level):
```
# deprovision window Apr 3 09:00 BST
revoke_sso --user nina.alvarez && 
revoke_gsuite --user nina.alvarez && 
rotate_service_keys --transfer-to samir.khan --owner nina.alvarez
```
We'll remove personal SSH keys from org hosts and revoke PATs.
Security Bot: Alert: Remember to rotate any infra secrets that referenced nina.alvarez (vault path: secret/team/analytics/nina). Recommended: rotate within 24h of token revocation.
Finance: Final invoice cutoff: submit by Apr 5 EOD BST for processing on the Apr 15 cycle. Include last month hours, any outstanding expenses with receipts, and bank details. For contractors in the UK, no COBRA applies. We'll email a confirmation of the final payment schedule.
Legal: Contract note: contractor-nav clause states IP assignment completed at contract termination but please sign the separation IP acknowledgment form we will send. Regarding options: contractors are not eligible for same exercise terms as employees; however, you have a separate contractor grant (grant id CG-2024-19). We'll email the grant summary and exercise window by Apr 6.
Nina Alvarez: Thanks. Also need a written reference from my manager if possible. Who should I ask?
Samir Khan: Happy to provide a short reference. DM me the role and timeline.
Hiring Ops: Looping in for knowledge capture: we'll post the successor hiring note and list access required for the role. Nina, can you add the top 5 permissions needed for the billing-export job?
Nina Alvarez: Done in the doc. Top perms: cloud_storage.read, db_export.write, analytics:query, billing:read, service-account:impersonate.
Lila (People Ops): Exit interview scheduled Apr 4 10:00 BST (video). people-ops-bot will send calendar and offboarding form. Nina, we'll also include the 401k/retirement vendor link if you had a US plan historically, else ignore.
Nina Alvarez: I had no US plan. Thanks for the clarity. Appreciate everyone's help. I'll upload final KT recording and the short notes by tomorrow. :pray:
